title: The test installation's viewers keep their accounts and watch history on the new server
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "The people watching on the current test installation keep their accounts and watch history when the new server replaces it" (D-20261128-rewrite-approved). The test installation runs the earlier server until the new one can replace it.
acceptanceCriteria: Every account of the test installation signs in to the new server with the password its person uses today; no device's earlier sign-in is carried over, so every device signs in again.
Every person's places, played marks and Continue watching are the same on the new server for every title found on both.
A title whose history can't be matched is reported to the operator with its reason, and its history is kept, not dropped.
Carrying over reads the earlier server's data and changes none of it, can be run against a copy first, and can be run again with the same result.
The operator documentation says how to carry over and how to go back.
notes: End of stage 1. Replacing the test installation is a change to the owner's servers and needs the owner's approval, and Octave's apps to sign in with; it is not part of this task. A general import from other media servers is not promised (D-20261128-rewrite-approved).
